2500.translation: We no reach all the goals wey we plan, but we finish the main tasks.

2501.translation: After we analyse sales change for each quarter, we see clear increase as second half of year start.

2502.translation: Written reports dey use formal -ㅂ니다 ending and passive or noun-like forms, like 판단됩니다 and 정리되었습니다, to sound objective. No use respectful -(으)시- for your own actions.

2503.translation: After review, we judge say making current procedure simpler fit reduce processing time to half.

2504.translation: This project budget spending rate low, so dem need prepare measures to improve am before year end.

2505.translation: Dem do this survey among 1,000 adults from their twenties reach their sixties.

2506.translation: For end of report, I arrange and attach future tasks and directions for improvement.

2507.translation: I dey report customer enquiries handling for Q3. Total enquiries na 2,400, wey increase by 8 percent from previous quarter. But average handling time reduce from two days to one. Our analysis na say putting common questions for help page reduce simple enquiries. However, refund enquiries increase instead, so we need separate response plan. For Q4, we plan to first improve guidance about refund procedure.

2508.translation: Minutes of the 3rd project review meeting. The matter na to adjust schedule for replacing office building ventilation system. Contractor report say parts arrive late, so construction go start two weeks later. General affairs manager accept this delay only on condition say work go finish before year-end audit. If expected completion date shift again, dem go immediately begin process to choose another contractor. Members agree to write this condition send to contractor. But this meeting no discuss who responsible for parts arriving late.

2509.translation: Notice about revised public parking fees. From the 1st of next month, basic fee go change from 600 won to 800 won per 30 minutes. But vehicles wey register for resident-priority parking and vehicles wey display disability permit go still pay old fee. Even for registered vehicles, if monthly use pass 100 hours, only the extra hours go use new fee. Extra income from this change go only go to facility repairs. Dem go publish detailed spending for website at year end.

2510.translation: Internal audit report. We check sample of forty goods-purchase contracts for first half of this year. Thirty-six follow procedure. For the other four, dem write the reason for direct, no-competition contract after signing the contract. But because all contract amounts below the threshold, dem no count am as rule violation. Still, make writing the reason later no become habit: from next quarter, responsible department must get the reason approved before contract. Audit team go check compliance again at quarter end.

2511.translation: Summary of budget review minutes for second half of year. Research and development department request extra 400 million won for equipment. Finance committee no approve everything: dem first allocate 200 million won. Dem go consider the rest only if this year equipment use rate pass 70 percent. Chair ask research and development department to prepare the criteria for calculating this rate before next meeting. The department no raise special objection.

2512.translation: Progress report on reducing permit processing time. This year average na 41 days, 9 days less than last year. Environmental-impact consultation still be the bottleneck; na there 60 percent of delayed cases dey. Responsible department go try handling consultation procedures at the same time, but dem no go shorten legal review period. Dem plan to gain time by reducing repeated requests for missing application documents. So the reduction go depend well-well on whether people submit complete documents from the start.

2513.translation: Report about forklift contact accident for distribution centre and the response. During night work last month, forklift touch worker for loading area, but the worker get only minor bruise. Investigation show say driver follow speed rule and forklift maintenance dey okay. But for dim area, pedestrian path no separate from vehicle path. Centre judge say direct cause na poor path design, no be individual carelessness, so dem decide no punish driver. Instead, dem go finish separating paths within two months. Until then, dem go limit night work for that area.

2514.translation: Statement about suspected leak of access records. Hangyeol Institute talk say external security-company inspection find signs say outsiders view some researchers login records last March. But dem never confirm whether those records contain information wey fit identify people. No damage cases don get reported for now. Institute say dem go publish results when checking finish. If dem find identifying information, dem go notify affected people one by one. Dem also plan full review of access-permission management because of this incident.

2515.translation: Inspection find some items wey pass required limit, so dem request corrective action.

2516.translation: I dey report below why budget spending rate no reach target and how we plan to make up for am.

2517.translation: If contract conditions change, dem must give written notice ahead.

2518.translation: Formal reports use -(으)ㄹ 경우에는 or -(으)면 for conditions, and -아/어야 합니다 or -기 바랍니다 for obligations.

2519.translation: This measure na temporary one. Final policy go get confirmation after committee discuss am.

2520.translation: If anything above change, abeg contact responsible department immediately.

2521.translation: If problem appear during trial run, you must stop operation immediately and report to person wey dey in charge.

2522.translation: Dem handle the matter according to relevant laws, and nobody raise separate objection.

2523.translation: I recommend make we hold this improvement plan for now because e save only small cost, but review am again later.

2525.translation: Words about schedules fit look alike but mean different things. Match the noun with the action wey dem describe.

2530.translation: free time wey person fit use

2533.translation: I want make we coordinate our schedules.

2534.translation: You contact partner to find meeting time wey fit both sides.

2535.translation: I already get appointment that day, so e go hard.

2537.translation: That time dey okay for me.

2538.translation: You accept the time wey the other person propose.

2540.translation: You apologise after changing plan with short notice.

2541.translation: I go let you know as soon as dem confirm am.

2542.translation: Schedule never final, and you promise to inform the other side.

2543.translation: We fit postpone am till next week?

2544.translation: You ask whether dem fit postpone meeting.

2545.translation: I go postpone meeting till next Tuesday.

2546.translation: E go dey okay to change am from three to four for afternoon?

2547.translation: Use -(으)시- when asking about the other person convenience. Use humble 드리다 verbs when apologising for your own actions.

2548.translation: I go make am final after I check attendees schedules.

2549.translation: Sorry, e be like say I need cancel this afternoon appointment.
